tool_schemas.name: create_entities
tool_schemas.description: Creates one or more entities and returns the newly created entity records (including their assigned mmt_ent_* ids and stored fields such as summary, properties, and confidence). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any entity is missing required fields, contains unknown fields, or has an invalid confidence value/type; raises UNAUTHORIZED if you don’t have access to the graph and RATE_LIMITED when write quotas are exceeded. Raises CONFLICT if an entity cannot be created due to a backend uniqueness/consistency constraint in your workspace.

summary.description: Short natural-language summary of the entity.

properties.description: Arbitrary structured properties for the entity.

confidence.description: Initial confidence score for the entity (typically 0.0-1.0).

tool_schemas.name: create_relations
tool_schemas.description: Creates multiple relations between existing entities and returns the created relation records (including their assigned mmt_rel_* ids, predicate, properties, and confidence). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any relation is missing required fields, contains unknown fields, has an invalid id format, or provides an invalid confidence value/type; raises NOT_FOUND if any referenced from_entity_id or to_entity_id does not exist (or is not visible to you). Raises UNAUTHORIZED if you don’t have access to the graph, RATE_LIMITED when write quotas are exceeded, and CONFLICT if the relation cannot be created due to a backend consistency constraint.

relations.description: List of relations to create between entities.

properties.description: Arbitrary structured properties for the relation.

confidence.description: Initial confidence score for the relation (typically 0.0-1.0).

tool_schemas.name: add_observations
tool_schemas.description: Adds one or more observations to existing entities and returns the created observation records (including their assigned mmt_obs_* ids and stored fields such as content, source, observed_at, and confidence). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any observation is missing required fields, contains unknown fields, uses an invalid entity_id format, or provides an invalid observed_at timestamp or confidence value/type; raises NOT_FOUND if any target entity_id does not exist (or is not visible to you). Raises UNAUTHORIZED if you don’t have access to the graph, RATE_LIMITED when write quotas are exceeded, and CONFLICT if an observation cannot be persisted due to a backend consistency constraint.

observations.description: List of observations to add to entities.

entity_id.description: Entity id the observation is attached to (mmt_ent_... ULID).

source.description: Source of the observation (e.g., URL, note, system, person).

observed_at.description: When the observation was observed (RFC3339 datetime).

tool_schemas.name: delete_entities
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the specified entities and also deletes their associated relations, returning a deletion result for the requested ids. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if entity_ids is empty or contains invalidly formatted ids; raises NOT_FOUND if any entity id does not exist (or is not visible to you). Raises UNAUTHORIZED if you don’t have access to the graph and RATE_LIMITED when write quotas are exceeded.

entity_ids.description: Entity ids to delete (associated relations are also deleted).

tool_schemas.name: delete_observations
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the specified observations and returns a deletion result for the requested ids. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if observation_ids is empty or contains invalidly formatted ids; raises NOT_FOUND if any observation id does not exist (or is not visible to you). Raises UNAUTHORIZED if you don’t have access to the graph and RATE_LIMITED when write quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: delete_relations
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the specified relations and returns a deletion result for the requested ids. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if relation_ids is empty or contains invalidly formatted ids; raises NOT_FOUND if any relation id does not exist (or is not visible to you). Raises UNAUTHORIZED if you don’t have access to the graph and RATE_LIMITED when write quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: get_relation
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single relation by id and returns the relation record with its stored/enhanced properties. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if relation_id is not a valid mmt_rel_* id; raises NOT_FOUND if the relation does not exist (or is not visible to you). Raises UNAUTHORIZED if you don’t have access to the graph.

tool_schemas.name: update_relation
tool_schemas.description: Updates fields on an existing relation and returns the updated relation record; when properties is provided it replaces the stored properties for that relation. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if relation_id is invalid, if unknown fields are supplied, or if provided predicate/confidence are invalid types/values; raises NOT_FOUND if the relation does not exist (or is not visible to you). Raises UNAUTHORIZED if you don’t have access to the graph, RATE_LIMITED when write quotas are exceeded, and CONFLICT if the update violates a backend consistency constraint.

predicate.description: Updated relation predicate in active voice.

properties.description: Updated structured properties for the relation (replaces stored properties).

confidence.description: Updated confidence score for the relation (typically 0.0-1.0).

tool_schemas.name: read_graph
tool_schemas.description: Reads the knowledge graph and returns a page of entities, relations, and observations, optionally including records marked deleted; results are paged with an opaque cursor and limited by limit across the returned collections. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if cursor/limit are invalid types or values; raises UNAUTHORIZED if you don’t have access to the graph. Raises RATE_LIMITED when read quotas are exceeded.

include_deleted.description: Whether to include entities/relations/observations marked deleted.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for iterating through the graph.

limit.description: Maximum number of records per page across the returned collections.

tool_schemas.name: search_nodes
tool_schemas.description: Searches entities by lexical match over names and summaries and returns a page of matching entities according to the requested filters and sort order; results are paged using an opaque cursor and capped by limit. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if query is missing/empty, if status/sort are not one of the allowed values, or if cursor/limit are invalid; raises UNAUTHORIZED if you don’t have access to the graph. Raises RATE_LIMITED when search quotas are exceeded.

query.description: Lexical search query to match against entity names and summaries.

limit.description: Maximum number of entities to return.

tool_schemas.name: open_nodes
tool_schemas.description: Resolves the requested entity names to entities in your Memento graph and returns the matching nodes (including their IDs and current fields), optionally including entities that are currently marked deleted. If multiple entities share a name, all matches are returned; this endpoint does not page results. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if names is empty or not an array of strings, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the graph, and NOT_FOUND only when none of the provided names exist (or all matches are deleted while include_deleted is false).

names.description: List of entity names to open.

include_deleted.description: Whether to include entities marked deleted when opening by name.

tool_schemas.name: semantic_search
tool_schemas.description: Embeds the provided query and returns the most similar entities by vector similarity, optionally filtered by entity_type and lifecycle status, in descending similarity order. Results are paged with limit and an opaque cursor; omit cursor for the first page and pass the returned cursor to fetch the next page until no cursor is returned. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/empty query, invalid status, non-positive limit, or invalid min_similarity, NOT_FOUND if the requested embedding model does not exist/has no index, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN or QUOTA_EXCEEDED when access or usage limits prevent running the search.

query.description: Natural-language query to embed and match against entity embeddings.

model.description: Embedding model name to use/match (must correspond to embeddings.model).

min_similarity.description: Minimum similarity threshold for returned matches.

limit.description: Maximum number of matching entities to return.

tool_schemas.name: get_entity_embedding
tool_schemas.description: Returns the stored embedding record for the given entity_id, optionally selecting a specific model when multiple embeddings exist. If model is omitted, the default/current embedding for the entity is returned when available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid entity_id format, NOT_FOUND if the entity does not exist or no embedding exists for the requested model, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you don’t have permission to read the entity or its embeddings.

entity_id.description: Entity ULID (mmt_ent_...) to fetch an embedding for.

model.description: Optional embedding model name to select a specific embedding.

tool_schemas.name: get_entity_history
tool_schemas.description: Returns the entity’s full version/event history in reverse chronological order (most recent first), paged with limit and an opaque cursor. Use cursor from the prior response to continue until no cursor is returned. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid entity_id format or invalid limit/cursor, NOT_FOUND if the entity does not exist, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the entity’s history.

entity_id.description: Entity ULID (mmt_ent_...) whose version/event history will be returned.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor over history events.

limit.description: Maximum number of history events to return.

tool_schemas.name: get_relation_history
tool_schemas.description: Returns the relation’s full version/event history in reverse chronological order (most recent first), paged with limit and an opaque cursor. Use cursor from the prior response to continue until no cursor is returned. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid relation_id format or invalid limit/cursor, NOT_FOUND if the relation does not exist, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the relation’s history.

relation_id.description: Relation ULID (mmt_rel_...) whose version/event history will be returned.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor over history events.

limit.description: Maximum number of history events to return.

tool_schemas.name: get_graph_at_time
tool_schemas.description: Reconstructs and returns the graph state as of the ISO-8601 timestamp at, including entities, relations, and observations that were effective at that point in time, optionally including items that were already deleted as of that time. The reconstructed result set is paged with limit and an opaque cursor; pass cursor to iterate through subsequent pages until no cursor is returned. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid at timestamp, invalid limit/cursor, or other inconsistent filters, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the graph, and NOT_FOUND if the requested point in time is outside the available history window.

at.description: Point-in-time timestamp (ISO 8601) to reconstruct the graph state.

include_deleted.description: Whether to include nodes/edges/observations that were deleted as of the requested time.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for iterating through the reconstructed graph.

limit.description: Maximum number of records per page across the returned collections.

tool_schemas.name: get_decayed_graph
tool_schemas.description: Returns a graph snapshot as of as_of (defaults to now) with confidence values time-decayed using half_life_seconds and filtered to items whose decayed confidence is at least min_confidence, optionally scoped to entity_ids or expanded from root_entity_id up to max_hops. Results are paged with limit and an opaque cursor over the returned entities (and their attached relations/observations as included by the snapshot); pass cursor to fetch the next page until no cursor is returned. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid timestamps, negative/zero half_life_seconds, out-of-range limit/max_hops, or providing invalid/malformed IDs, NOT_FOUND if any specified entity_ids/root_entity_id do not exist, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the requested graph content.

as_of.description: Point-in-time timestamp to reconstruct the graph (defaults to now if omitted).

half_life_seconds.description: Half-life in seconds used to decay confidence values based on time since last update/observation.

min_confidence.description: Minimum decayed confidence threshold; items below this are omitted.

include_deleted.description: Whether to include soft-deleted entities/relations/observations in the returned graph.

entity_ids.description: Optional list of entity ULIDs to scope the returned graph.

root_entity_id.description: Optional root entity ULID to expand from when building a subgraph.

max_hops.description: Maximum relationship hops to traverse from root_entity_id when returning a subgraph.

limit.description: Maximum number of entities to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: force_generate_embedding
tool_schemas.description: Queues or generates an embedding for the specified entity and stores it under the selected model, optionally overwriting an existing ready embedding when overwrite is true. Returns the embedding status (e.g., queued/generating/ready/failed) and the stored embedding metadata when available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid entity_id or missing/invalid model, NOT_FOUND if the entity does not exist, CONFLICT if an embedding generation is already in progress and overwrite is false, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN or QUOTA_EXCEEDED if embedding generation is not permitted or exceeds configured limits.

entity_id.description: Entity ULID to generate and store an embedding for.

model.description: Embedding model identifier to use for generation and storage.

overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite an existing ready embedding even if content_hash matches.

tool_schemas.name: debug_embedding_config
tool_schemas.description: Returns embedding configuration and health/status information for the current workspace, optionally including per-entity embedding status for entity_id and recent embedding-related graph events when include_recent_events is true (bounded by events_limit). This endpoint is not paged; it returns a single diagnostic payload. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid entity_id/model or out-of-range events_limit, NOT_FOUND if entity_id is provided but does not exist, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you’re not allowed to access diagnostic information.

entity_id.description: Optional entity ULID to inspect embedding status/config for a specific entity.

model.description: Optional embedding model identifier to filter debugging output.

include_recent_events.description: Whether to include recent embedding-related graph_events in the debug output.

events_limit.description: Maximum number of recent embedding-related events to include when include_recent_events is true.

tool_schemas.name: diagnose_vector_search
tool_schemas.description: Runs a diagnostic nearest-neighbor query directly against the vector index for the provided query and model and returns the top matches with similarity scores, optionally including raw vectors, missing embeddings, and filtering candidates by embedding status. Results are not cursor-paged; limit controls the maximum neighbors returned in the diagnostic payload. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/empty query, invalid status filter values, or out-of-range limit, NOT_FOUND if the specified model/index is not available, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you’re not permitted to run diagnostic database-level search.

query.description: Natural-language query string to run against the vector index.

model.description: Embedding model identifier to use/target for the diagnostic search.

limit.description: Maximum number of nearest neighbors to return.

min_score.description: Optional minimum similarity score threshold for returned results.

include_vectors.description: Whether to include raw embedding vectors in the diagnostic response.

include_missing.description: Whether to include entities whose embeddings are not ready (missing/queued/generating/failed) in diagnostics.

status.description: Optional list of embedding statuses to filter the candidate set.

tool_schemas.name: list_entities
tool_schemas.description: Lists entities visible to the caller. Returns active entities by default; set include_deleted=true to include soft-deleted records. Supports simple filtering and cursor pagination. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filters or cursor; UNAUTHORIZED if you don’t have access to the graph; RATE_LIMITED when read quotas are exceeded.

query.description: Optional substring match against entity name (case-insensitive).

entity_type.description: Optional exact match filter for entity_type.

status.description: Optional lifecycle status filter. Defaults to active unless include_deleted is true.

include_deleted.description: When true, include entities with status='deleted' in results. Defaults to false.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (1-200). Defaults to 50.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a prior call.

sort.description: Sort order for results. Defaults to updated_at_desc.

tool_schemas.name: get_entity
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single entity by id. Returns the entity record (including status and deleted_at when applicable). Raises NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist (or is not visible to you); VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid id format; UNAUTHORIZED if you don’t have access to the graph; RATE_LIMITED when read quotas are exceeded.

include_deleted.description: When true, allow returning a soft-deleted entity. Defaults to false.

tool_schemas.name: update_entity
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing active entity and returns the updated entity record. Only active entities may be updated. Emits an entity.updated graph event. Raises NOT_FOUND if the entity does not exist (or is not visible to you); CONFLICT if the entity is deleted; VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid fields/types or confidence out of range; UNAUTHORIZED if you don’t have access to the graph; RATE_LIMITED when write quotas are exceeded.

name.description: New human-readable name. If provided, must be non-empty.

properties.description: Replaces the structured properties object for the entity.

confidence.description: Sets the confidence score for the entity (0.0-1.0).

confidence_updated_at.description: Override timestamp for confidence update (RFC3339 datetime). If omitted, server sets to now().

metadata.name: Memento
metadata.description: Memento stores a personal/team knowledge graph consisting of entities (nodes), relations (edges), and observations (fact-like annotations) with time-aware confidence and full version history. The main workflows are creating/updating/deleting graph primitives, searching nodes lexically and semantical
